##### Project general facts

Equiterra is an equestrian-inspired residential community within Grand Polo Club and Resort by Emaar. The development combines contemporary architecture with landscaped green spaces and polo fields, creating a tranquil residential setting inspired by the heritage of polo. It offers a selection of townhouse-plexes and five-bedroom luxury residences.

The community features a range of lifestyle amenities centred around The Clubhouse, The Stables, and the Polo Fields. Residents can enjoy riding arenas, a linear park, yoga platforms, an amphitheatre, fitness zones, swimming pools, padel courts, and children’s playgrounds. These facilities support an active outdoor lifestyle, wellness, and community connection.

The residences feature modern finishes using high-quality materials. Interiors draw inspiration from the natural surroundings, with soft neutral colour palettes, rich textures, and contemporary craftsmanship. Large windows and open layouts enhance natural light and the connection to the landscape. Kitchens are equipped, and the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Equiterra is part of Grand Polo Club and Resort, situated in Dubai Investment Park 2. Surrounded by expansive green spaces and polo fields, the community offers a peaceful setting with a strong equestrian identity, appealing to residents who value outdoor living and a connection to nature.

The wider development is designed as a lifestyle destination that combines residential living with leisure, wellness, and landscaped outdoor spaces. Dedicated riding areas and trails, polo facilities, and beautifully maintained parks contribute to its distinctive character, while modern amenities support everyday comfort.

The location provides access to key destinations across Dubai, offering a balance between a tranquil residential environment and city connectivity. The development also incorporates eco-conscious principles, including energy-efficient solutions and sustainable materials, reflecting a focus on environmental responsibility.
